title: MSI Center – How to gain SYSTEM privileges in seconds
summary: A security research article demonstrating a privilege escalation vulnerability in MSI Center software that allows attackers to gain SYSTEM-level privileges on Windows systems in seconds.
problem_solved: Exposes and documents a critical privilege escalation vulnerability that bypasses standard Windows security boundaries.
why_valuable: Critical security disclosure that helps system administrators patch systems and security researchers understand MSI software attack surfaces.
